company.name: Longline Labs
company._note: `name` is the brand beside every wordmark; `legalName` is what every site's copyright line says (the shared footer reads it, and no site may override it). `url` is the company site, where the Linked LL in every header leads.
company.familyLine: Apps for community association managers, built to work the same way.

_note: The family, in the order of the six-colour longline. `status` is "live" (the site is up: the switcher and the family section link to it) or "coming-soon" (shown with its mark and accent, labelled Coming soon, not linked). Flip one word to launch. `switcher` says whether the header's switcher lists the app at all. Domains as decided October 30, 2026: ballastbook.com, shipshapefiles.com (the product is ShipShape), aboveboarddocs.com.

apps.name: Coifish
apps.description: Automated vendor COI tracking. Coifish reminds vendors when their insurance is expiring and collects the new certificates, so you don’t have to.

apps.name: ReelMinder
apps.description: Tracks every Association deadline, from insurance expirations and contract renewals to meeting notice dates, and reminds you before each one.

apps.name: PacketSkipper
apps.description: Builds Board meeting packets, records minutes, and tracks action items until you check them off.

apps.name: BallastBook
apps.description: A simple, straightforward Annual Budget builder for each of your Associations.

apps.name: ShipShape
apps.description: Automatically renames every file to your own custom naming convention, so documents are always easy to find.

apps.name: AboveBoard
apps.description: An easy-to-use public database where each Association can post its Governing Documents, minutes and records.
